title: ResponseEnvelope
description: The single response shape every tool returns; doubles as each tool's MCP outputSchema (SDD 4.2). Version 1. Evolution within a major is strictly additive: new optional fields only, checked against schemas/baselines/envelope.v1.schema.json.

v.description: Envelope schema version, resolved per request via _meta negotiation (workbench/maxEnvelopeVersion) and mirrored here.

freshness.description: Freshness tier of the answer (SDD 7.3.3). Carried on every success envelope.

results.description: Tool-specific results, always ranked and grouped.

truncation.description: Present if and only if results were cut. Truncation is never silent: a cut always carries dropped, reason, narrow and cursor.

narrow.description: Typed refinement hints, e.g. kind:function or path:src/**.

error.description: Failure payload. The code taxonomy and its one-code-one-recovery invariant are owned by chunk:m0-error-taxonomy; the envelope owns the shape and the five recovery classes.

code.description: Machine-readable error code from the published taxonomy (SDD 4.3).

parserMessage.description: PARSE_REJECTED: the parser's own message for the syntax break (SDD 4.3).

rejectedDiff.description: PARSE_REJECTED: the diff that was rolled back (SDD 4.3).

contentHash.description: STALE_ANCHOR: fresh content hash of the file that moved under the diff (SDD 4.3).

confirmToken.description: CONFIRM_REQUIRED: the HMAC-sealed confirm grant for the offered diff (SDD 9.4). Re-invoke the same call with confirm set to this token to apply.

backoffMs.description: ENGINE_BUSY: suggested backoff before retrying, milliseconds (SDD 4.3).

plugin.description: PLUGIN_CRASHED: the plugin that trapped or exhausted fuel (SDD 4.3).

oneOf.description: Success envelope: carries freshness, budget and results; never an error.
Failure envelope: carries the error; never results or a truncation manifest.
